evals.prompt: Find all living room lights in Home Assistant, check their current states, and create a new automation that turns them on at sunset with best-practice validation.
evals.expected_output: Resolve exact entities via ha_search / ha_list_floors_areas / ha_get_state, consult ha_get_skill_guide before writing the automation, pass MandatoryBPS=false afterward if appropriate, and create the automation via ha_config_set_automation.
assertions: Resolves entity/area IDs with ha_search, ha_get_overview, or ha_list_floors_areas before creating the automation
Uses ha_config_set_automation (not raw YAML or external scripts)

evals.prompt: We connected our MCP client to /mcp/catalog/search so we only see a handful of tools, and we need to inspect a dashboard layout and trigger an automation trace debug.
evals.expected_output: Use ha_search_tools(query='...') with English keywords to locate ha_config_get_dashboard and ha_get_automation_traces, then fetch full schemas via ha_search_tools(tools=[...]) before invoking them directly or sequentially through ha_call_read_tool.
assertions: Explains calling ha_search_tools(query=...) with English keywords
Explains fetching full schemas via ha_search_tools(tools=[...]) before calling
Notes that proxy tools like ha_call_read_tool must be called sequentially with top-level name and arguments

evals.prompt: Rename media_player.old_speaker to media_player.kitchen_speaker in Home Assistant, and explain why ha_config_set_yaml returned a disabled error.
evals.expected_output: Rename the entity using ha_set_entity (underscores required, no hyphens) rather than external WebSocket scripts, and explain that ha_config_set_yaml is disabled by default unless ENABLE_YAML_CONFIG_EDITING=true is set on the server.
assertions: Uses ha_set_entity for entity ID/friendly-name updates (and notes underscore rule)
